verdict.rationale: The evidence documents automatic meeting summaries, action items and decisions, plus an API for passing transcripts to an LLM. None of it shows Fellow drafting a follow-up email that a user can review and send in a couple of clicks. The API and MCP access are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks
